fixed.explanation: In _parse_sheet, header_names gets one entry per header row. When the sheet has only header rows, the parser returns an empty frame whose columns are a flat Index with one level. The unconditional set_names call then gets a 2-item list and raises "Expected 1 names, got 2". The fix applies header_names only when the number of levels equals len(header_names).

query.intent: Excel reader's parse path (TextParser / python parser) handling header=[0,1] with index_col=0 on a table where the data has only header rows; the multi-index header handling and index_col processing in read_excel's sheet parsing raises a ValueError when the data is empty after the header rows.
query.symptom: read_excel with header=[0,1] and index_col=0 raises ValueError "Expected 1 names, got 2" (sheet 0), while read_csv with the same options returns an empty DataFrame.
